slot_scores.evidence_quote: Objective function: Maximize total net income? The brief mentions "annual net income" for each activity and "external work earnings." Is the objective to maximize total income (crops + animals + external work)? This seems clear but let me confirm.
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly identified the objective as an open slot and asked to confirm whether it is to maximize total income/net income.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The only hidden slot, H1, was explicitly asked about and confirmed before the agent declared READY_TO_MODEL.

summary: The agent explicitly identified and confirmed the sole hidden objective slot before modeling, then stopped appropriately; interaction quality is strong for this case.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
